summary: Reitar Logtech Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit announcing progress on strategic cooperation between its indirect subsidiary Jingxing HK and Cainiao Group. The announcement covers delivery-phase status for two automated warehouse projects in Spain and the Netherlands and an expected commencement of a North American automated cold-storage project with an estimated contract value of approximately US$30 million. No financial terms, deal structure, or special-situation elements are disclosed; this is routine operational and project update news for a foreign private issuer.
